entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 438829629114680704: position at J2016.0. Distance: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 16895: the Hipparcos parallax the radius was computed with (van Leeuwen 2007), 89.88 +/- 0.23 mas, inverted (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/746/1/101): 11.126 +/- 0.028 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 89.6850 +/- 0.1638 mas (same row, RUWE 3.17), 547.5 standard errors, is not used. entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 1.319 +/- 0.011 solar radii from Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 16895: radius in solar radii, from the limb-darkened angular diameter 1.103 +/- 0.009 mas (CHARA) and the Hipparcos parallax, 1.319 +/- 0.011 (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/746/1/101). Mass 1.138 +/- 0.01 solar masses from Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 16895: mass in solar masses, from Yonsei-Yale isochrones at the measured radius and temperature (a model value), 1.138 +/- 0.01 (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/746/1/101). Temperature 6157 +/- 37 K from Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 16895: effective temperature in K, from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux, 6157 +/- 37.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: Kharitonov, Tereshchenko & Knyazeva (1988), Spectrophotometric Catalogue of Stars (Alma-Ata), record 136: HR 799; VizieR III/202, cross-checked against Gaia DR3 XP spectrum, source 438829629114680704 (17 levels apart at most, the threshold is 12), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffedf6. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 16895 is not in the library; pulkovo: HR 799 is not in the catalogue; kiehling: HR 799 is not among its 60 stars; burnashev: BS 799 is not in part2; kharitonov: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 6,157 K and log g 4.25 (u1 0.390, u2 0.298): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
